notes: Defect: promo code discount amount is not displayed correctly for return trip tickets in Mozio email confirmations. The return-trip mapping path (create-reservations.mappers, map-line-item-return-trip-modification, apply-report-discounts) likely fails to propagate or correctly compute the discount amount when the return-trip modification is applied, causing the sanitized dispatch sent to Mozio to omit or misrepresent the promo amount.

notes: Openspec provided empty acceptance criteria with only a descriptive note about the defect. I created the full set of criteria from scratch based on the defect description and the listed technical files. AC-1 is the core fix verification. AC-2 guards against regression on one-way trips. AC-3 covers the combined outbound+return scenario. AC-4 and AC-5 cover edge cases (zero discount, no discount). AC-6 targets the specific apply-report-discounts computation path to ensure return-trip parity with one-way. AC-7 ensures end-to-end consistency through the webhook callback path mentioned in the technical notes.
